name: virtual-ai-assistant
description: Full-stack Virtual AI Assistant with React, Vite, Express, TypeScript, Prisma, and Anthropic Claude streaming

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
